cycles.closeConfirmBody: Closing ends the year. A closed cycle cannot be reopened, and its deadlines can no longer change.

cycles.editNote: The cycle is still a draft, so these dates are not binding on anyone yet.
cycles.extendNote: Moving a deadline on an open cycle is a formal extension. It is recorded in the audit trail with your name on it.

roleHint.HR_SUPER_ADMIN: Everything: configuration, calibration, the master export, and granting these roles.
roleHint.HRBP: Runs the cycle org-wide, but does not configure the organization.
roleHint.EXECUTIVE_VIEWER: Sees the whole organization, read-only, and acts on nothing.

roles.ownSuperAdminNote: You cannot remove your own HR Super Admin role — it is the only role that can grant itself. Ask another Super Admin to do it.
roles.saveFailed: Could not update the HR roles.

goalSetting.notPermitted: Goal setting is drafted by line managers and HR. Your own KPI set is on your home page.
goalSetting.loadFailed: Could not load the goal-setting roster.
goalSetting.noCycles: No performance cycle exists yet. HR opens the year before goal setting can start.

goalSetting.empty: Nobody is enrolled under you for this performance year.
goalSetting.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} participants. Search to narrow the list.

stage.title: Goal setting
stage.notConfigured: This cycle has no goal-setting stage yet, so nothing can be drafted or signed on it.

stage.notYetOpenBody: Nothing can be drafted or signed until the stage opens.
stage.graceNote: HR has {days} days of grace after the deadline to intervene.

kpi.title: KPIs for {name}
kpi.subtitleEditable: Six texts per KPI: what is measured, and what each of the five levels looks like.
kpi.subtitleReadOnly: The KPI set as it stands. You can read it, but you are not its owner.
kpi.deleteConfirmBody: The KPI and its five level descriptors go with it, and the weightage total drops by its share.
kpi.empty: No KPIs yet. Add the first one — the set can be signed once the weightages total 100%.
kpi.emptyReadOnly: No KPIs have been drafted for this employee yet.
kpi.exemptTitle: No goal setting for this employee
kpi.exemptBody: C-Level employees skip goal setting entirely, so there is nothing to draft or sign here.
kpi.weightageComplete: The set totals 100% and can be signed.
kpi.weightageOnTrack: A draft may sit at any total while you work. 100% is what sign-off needs.
kpi.signOffBody: Both parties sign to record agreement. A signature is not the lock — HR approval is.
kpi.noRejectNote: There is no reject button. A party who does not agree simply does not sign, and the conversation happens away from this screen.
kpi.alreadySignedToast: That signature was already on file
kpi.approvedBody: Approved {datetime}. The set is locked as the agreed baseline; a change now goes through a mid-year change request.
kpi.blockedTitle: This KPI set cannot be edited right now
kpi.formNote: All six texts are required. The five levels are what the employee will be rated against at year-end.

form.descriptionHelp: One outcome, stated so both of you would agree whether it was met.
form.weightageHelp: This KPI's share of the set, as a percentage with up to two decimals.
form.levelHelp: What performance at this level looks like.

validation.descriptorRequired: Describe what this level looks like.
validation.weightage: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, with at most two decimals.
validation.tooLong: Keep this to 2000 characters or fewer.

kpi.signedStale: The KPI set changed after this signature, so it was given to an earlier version.

hrApproval.title: HR approval
hrApproval.subtitle: §5.1 — HR reviews and approves. Approval is what locks the KPIs as the agreed baseline.
hrApproval.readySigned: Both parties have signed and the set totals 100%. Approving now locks it as the agreed baseline.
hrApproval.readyUnsigned: The goal-setting deadline has passed without the employee's signature (§5.4), and the set moved to HR review. Approving records the lock on that basis, not as a mutual agreement.
hrApproval.effectBaseline: The KPI set becomes the baseline the whole year is measured against — self-assessment, the manager's rating, the score and the bonus all read it.
hrApproval.effectEdits: Nobody can edit the set afterwards. A correction goes through a mid-year change request (§6.2), which the manager raises and HR decides.
hrApproval.effectYearEnd: Year-end sign-off refuses to open for this employee until this approval exists, so nothing downstream can start without it.
hrApproval.confirmTitle: Lock this KPI set as the baseline?
hrApproval.confirmSigned: Both parties signed. This records HR's approval of an agreed set.
hrApproval.confirmUnsigned: The employee did not sign before the deadline. This records HR's approval over an absent signature, and the record will say so.
hrApproval.confirmBody: There is no unapprove. Once the baseline is locked, the only way to change a KPI is a mid-year change request (§6.2).
hrApproval.approvedToast: The KPI set is approved and locked
hrApproval.lockedSubtitle: §5.1 — HR's approval is the lock, and there is no unapprove.
hrApproval.lockedBody: Approved {datetime}. A change from here is a mid-year change request (§6.2).

home.myTasksSubtitle: Everything waiting on you, whichever role put it there.
home.oversightSubtitle: What you are entitled to see, whether or not you act on it.
home.noEmployeeRecord: This account is not linked to an employee record yet, so it has no performance tasks. HR links the two when the employee data is imported.
home.noOpenCycle: No performance cycle is open. Tasks and deadlines appear here once HR opens the year.
home.empty: Nothing is waiting on you in the {year} cycle.

home.ownSetWaiting: Your manager has not finished drafting your KPIs yet.

home.chainBody: You can see everyone below you, however deep, and act on your direct reports only.
home.orgBody: HR sees every participant in the cycle and every deadline behind them.
home.readOnlyBody: You can see the organisation's performance data and act on none of it.
home.directoryBody: The employees you are entitled to see, with their department and manager.
home.threeSixtyStart: HR asked you to assess them. Four questions plus optional comments.
home.threeSixtyResume: You have started this one — your saved answers are still there.

midYear.title: Mid-year review
midYear.subtitle: Raise and decide changes to an approved KPI baseline. No scoring happens at mid-year (§2).
midYear.notPermitted: Raising a change request belongs to the direct line manager, and deciding one to HR. If your own KPIs change, you will see it on your KPI screen.
midYear.loadFailed: The mid-year workspace could not be loaded.
midYear.noCycles: No performance cycle exists yet. HR opens one before mid-year can run.
midYear.queueSubtitle: Change requests that have been raised and not yet decided.
midYear.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting on a decision.

stage.title: Mid-year
stage.notConfigured: This cycle has no mid-year stage yet, so no change request can be raised on it.
stage.lockedBody: The deadline passed, so no new change request can be raised. HR can still decide one that is already pending, and can reopen the stage by extending the deadline.
stage.notYetOpenBody: No change request can be raised until the stage opens.
stage.graceNote: HR has {days} days of grace after the deadline to intervene.

midYear.rosterEmpty: No one is enrolled in this cycle yet.

changeRequest.title: Propose a change
changeRequest.subtitle: Weightages must still total exactly 100%, so rebalance the whole set in one request (§5.3).
changeRequest.mustTotal: A request can only be approved when the set totals exactly 100%.
changeRequest.rationalePlaceholder: What changed about the role, the targets or the business?
changeRequest.rationaleHelp: HR reads this when deciding. It is stored with the request either way.
changeRequest.submitFailed: The change request could not be sent.
changeRequest.kpiGone: This KPI is no longer in the set
changeRequest.reasonPlaceholder: Required when rejecting; the manager sees it.
changeRequest.reasonHelp: A rejection must carry a reason (§6.2). An approval may leave this blank.
changeRequest.decideFailed: The decision could not be recorded.
changeRequest.withdrawHelp: The request stays on the record as withdrawn; nothing is deleted (§6.3).
changeRequest.withdrawFailed: The request could not be withdrawn.
changeRequest.decidedSubtitle: Everything that was asked for on this KPI set, decided or withdrawn.
changeRequest.historySubtitle: Superseded KPI versions, archived and never overwritten (§6.3).
changeRequest.historyEmptyBody: No KPI on this set has been changed yet, so the live version is the only one.
changeRequest.exemptTitle: No mid-year changes for this participant
changeRequest.exemptBody: C-Level employees skip goal-setting entirely (§8.3), so there is no KPI baseline to change.
changeRequest.notYours: A change request is raised by your line manager, not by you (§6.2). If your KPIs need to change, speak to them — the conversation happens offline and the request is recorded here.

yearEnd.title: Year-end assessment
yearEnd.subtitle: Self-assess against the KPIs agreed at goal-setting, then the manager reviews and both sign (§7.1).
yearEnd.notPermitted: The year-end assessment is between an employee and their direct line manager. Your own assessment reaches you through My Tasks.
yearEnd.loadFailed: The year-end workspace could not be loaded.
yearEnd.noCycles: No performance cycle exists yet. HR opens one before year-end can run.
yearEnd.progressSubtitle: Both parties rate every KPI before either can sign (§7.1).
yearEnd.chooseLevel: Choose the level that describes the year
yearEnd.divergenceHelp: This differs from the employee's self-assessment (level {employeeLevel}). The reason is shown to them and is what calibration reads later.
yearEnd.ratingFailed: The rating could not be saved.
yearEnd.signSubtitle: Both parties sign the final ratings. There is no reject — an unsigned assessment is the signal that the discussion is not finished (§5.3).
yearEnd.signFailed: The signature could not be recorded.
yearEnd.signBlocked: Signing opens once both parties have rated every KPI.
yearEnd.exemptTitle: No year-end assessment for this participant
yearEnd.exemptBody: C-Level employees skip self-assessment entirely (§8.3) — their final score is the entity's Corporate score, passed straight through.

stage.title: Year-end
stage.notConfigured: This cycle has no year-end stage yet, so no assessment can be recorded on it.

scorecard.bandHint: How your score maps onto the performance bands
scorecard.threeSixtyHint: The consolidated figure across everyone who assessed you

scorecard.noComments: No written comments were left this year.

scorecard.commentsWithheld: Written feedback is not shown this year — too few people completed your assessment for their comments to stay anonymous. Your 360 score above still includes everything that came back.

team.noChain: Nobody reports below your direct reports.

reports.noCyclesHelp: Reports appear once HR opens a cycle.

compliance.help: Every deadline miss and escalation, per manager.

compliance.employeeOwnHelp: Recorded, and deliberately kept off any manager's record.

distribution.noRun: No scores have been calculated yet
distribution.noRunHelp: Run the score calculation for this cycle first.

bonus.loadFailed: Could not load the bonus report
bonus.loadFailedHelp: Something went wrong fetching the report.

master.help: Every component, both scores, both bands, and every calibration reason.
master.none: No scored rows for this cycle.
master.loadFailed: Could not load the master results
master.loadFailedHelp: Something went wrong fetching the report.

executive.title: Executive dashboard
executive.subtitle: Org-wide distributions, completion, compliance and bonus totals.
executive.complianceHelp: Counts only. Named detail is on the manager compliance report.
executive.distributionHelp: The bands people were actually placed in.
executive.noScoresHelp: Distributions appear once the score run has been made for this cycle.
executive.drillDownHelp: Open any person's full record, including salary and bonus.
executive.notPermitted: This dashboard is for HR and top management
executive.notPermittedHelp: Your own team's status is on the My team screen.
executive.noCyclesHelp: The dashboard fills in once HR opens a cycle.
executive.loadFailedHelp: Something went wrong fetching the aggregates.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.subtitle: Target distribution against actual, and the band moves that close the gap.
calibration.orgWideHelp: Guidance, not a rule — the curve is never applied automatically.
calibration.belowThreshold: {count} people — below the {min} minimum, so no curve applies
calibration.notReadyHelp: Every participant needs a raw score before the curve can be looked at.
calibration.notPermitted: Calibration is HR Super Admin only
calibration.noCyclesHelp: Calibration opens once a cycle has been scored.
calibration.loadFailedHelp: Something went wrong fetching the distribution.
calibration.thinThreeSixty: 360 averaged over {count} rater(s), not the three §9.4 intends — a thinner sample than the rest of this department.

calibrationTarget.title: Target distribution
calibrationTarget.help: What share of people should land in each band. Guidance for the moves below — it never moves anyone by itself.
calibrationTarget.noTargetHelp: No target is set for this cycle, so calibration cannot start and results cannot be released. Set one to open the gate.
calibrationTarget.mustTotal: The five bands must total exactly 100%.
calibrationTarget.minSizeHelp: Departments below this keep their raw scores as final. You can still move any individual by hand.

scoreRun.title: Calculate raw scores
scoreRun.help: §8's calculation, and the step calibration waits on. Every signed assessment becomes one raw score and one band.
scoreRun.neverRun: No scores have been calculated for this cycle yet. {count} participant(s) are waiting.
scoreRun.rerunSafe: Recalculating writes a new set of raw scores and never overwrites an earlier one, so any calibration already applied survives.
scoreRun.loadFailed: Could not load previous score runs.

publish.title: Release results
publish.help: Everyone's results go live at the same moment. Nothing shows to employees before that.
publish.publishWarning: Publishing makes every employee's band, score and 360 feedback visible immediately. It can be reversed, but people may have already looked.
publish.unpublishWarning: Un-publishing hides every employee's result again. Anyone who has already seen theirs will have seen it.
publish.confirmHelp: This step exists so results cannot be released by a stray click.
publish.publishedToast: Results are now visible to employees.
publish.loadFailed: Could not load the publication state.

threeSixty.title: 360 assessment
threeSixty.subtitle: Rater assignments and the launch of the annual 360.
threeSixty.shortfallHelp: {count} employees do not yet have three raters. The cycle cannot be activated until they do.
threeSixty.noTemplates: No question sets have been created for this 360.
threeSixty.assignmentsHelp: Generated from the reporting mapping, then edited by HR before launch.
threeSixty.noAssignments: No assignments have been generated yet.
threeSixty.noThreeSixtyHelp: A 360 is set up alongside the performance year it belongs to.
threeSixty.notPermittedHelp: Assessments you have been asked to complete appear on the home page.
threeSixty.noCyclesHelp: A 360 hangs off a performance cycle.

threeSixtyForm.title: 360 assessment
threeSixtyForm.subtitle: Your answers are combined with the other raters' and never shown attributed to you.
threeSixtyForm.questionsHelp: Four points, no middle option — pick the one closest to what you have seen.
threeSixtyForm.openEndedPlaceholder: Optional. Combined with the other raters' comments, unattributed.
threeSixtyForm.finishHelp: Save as you go. Submitting is final — you cannot reopen an assessment.
threeSixtyForm.loadFailedHelp: It may have been reassigned, or the 360 cycle may have closed.

threeSixtySetup.title: Set up the 360
threeSixtySetup.help: The cycle and its three question sets are created together — a 360 with no questions cannot be answered.
threeSixtySetup.deadlineAfterOpens: The deadline has to fall after the cycle opens.
threeSixtySetup.createdToast: 360 cycle created. Generate the rater assignments next.
threeSixtySetup.starterHelp: A starting point, not a recommendation — edit or delete anything here.
threeSixtySetup.needsScored: This set needs at least one scored question — the 360 score is the answered scores divided by the form's maximum, and open-ended answers carry none.
threeSixtySetup.whatNextHelp: Creating the cycle does not invite anyone. You generate the rater assignments from the reporting lines, review them, and only then activate — which is the moment raters can start answering.

threeSixtyWindow.title: 360 window
threeSixtyWindow.help: When raters can answer, and when the forms lock. Correctable while the cycle is a draft — once it is activated, the dates are in everyone's task list and §5.4 makes the deadline a hard lock.
threeSixtyWindow.deadlineAfterOpens: The deadline must fall after the cycle opens.

threeSixtyResult.title: 360 feedback
threeSixtyResult.help: The consolidated result for this person (§9.5, §9.8). Comments arrive combined and unattributed — §13.1 — so nothing here identifies a rater.
threeSixtyResult.noCycle: No 360 cycle has been set up for the selected performance year.
threeSixtyResult.noResult: No 360 forms have been submitted for this person yet.
threeSixtyResult.shortWarning: This score comes from {count} of the {expected} assessments §9.4 intends, so it rests on a smaller sample than the rest. Treat it with the same caution at calibration.
threeSixtyResult.anonymityNote: No rater identity is carried here. A question is named only where more than one person answered it.
threeSixtyResult.loadFailed: The 360 result could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

raterEditor.title: Raters for {name}
raterEditor.help: Exactly three per employee. Saving replaces the whole list.
raterEditor.pickerNote: Anyone active can be picked here; the system still refuses self-assessment, C-Level and leavers when you save.

projects.title: Projects
projects.help: Optional. Link people who worked together so peers can be drawn from shared project work, not just their department.
projects.nameNote: Saving under a name that already exists replaces that project's membership.
projects.existingHelp: Membership feeds the peer pool when rater assignments are generated.
projects.none: No projects yet — peers will be drawn from each person's own department.

leaver.title: Record a departure
leaver.help: §12.1 — for an immediate resignation, rather than waiting for the next import.
leaver.notePlaceholder: Recorded on the audit trail, not on the employee record
leaver.consequences: Their direct reports roll up to their manager one level, pending actions stop chasing them, and any 360 they were rating is flagged for reassignment. The record itself is kept, never deleted.

transfer.title: Record a transfer
transfer.help: §12.3 — a mid-cycle move between departments splits the performance year in two.
transfer.dateNote: Each period is weighted by days ÷ 365, so this date changes the score.
transfer.consequences: The year splits at this date. Each department's manager drafts and assesses their own portion, and the departmental and corporate scores follow the periods.

strategyScores.title: Corporate & departmental scores
strategyScores.subtitle: The Strategy team's figures, keyed in by HR.
strategyScores.corporateHelp: One per entity. Every employee of that entity receives it.
strategyScores.departmentalHelp: One per department. The Individual track does not use these.
strategyScores.noDepartments: No departments are set up yet.
strategyScores.outstandingHint: Scoring cannot run until every one is in
strategyScores.notPermitted: These figures are keyed in by HR
strategyScores.notPermittedHelp: Ask HR if a score looks wrong.
strategyScores.noCyclesHelp: Scores attach to a performance cycle.

edgeCases.title: Leavers, roll-ups & transfers
edgeCases.subtitle: The consequences of a departure or a move, so none of them persist silently.
edgeCases.rollUpsHelp: Their manager left and they moved up one level. Each needs a permanent manager.
edgeCases.noRollUps: Nobody is waiting on a permanent manager.
edgeCases.unmanaged: {from} left, and there was nobody above them. This person has no manager.
edgeCases.reassignmentsHelp: Each ratee still needs three completed assessments.
edgeCases.transfersHelp: Each department's manager owns their own portion; the score is day-weighted.
edgeCases.notPermittedHelp: Ask HR if a reporting line looks wrong.

editEmployee.title: Edit this employee record
editEmployee.help: HR's correction path for a record that came in wrong — a misspelt name, the wrong department, a role track that does not match the job. It replaces the org record only; nothing about their performance year moves.
editEmployee.roleTrackHelp: §8.3 weights the score differently for each track, so changing it changes how this person is scored. C-Level skip goal setting, self-assessment and 360 entirely.
editEmployee.entityHelp: Departments belong to one entity, so moving someone between entities means choosing their department again.
editEmployee.noDepartmentCLevel: C-Level employees are tagged to an entity directly and have no department (§1.2).
editEmployee.managerHelp: §4.2 gives editing and sign-off to the direct line manager, so this decides who drafts and signs this person's KPIs.
editEmployee.notEditedHere: Employee ID, salary, HR roles and leaver status are not edited here. The ID never changes (§3.2); a departure goes through the edge-case screen so the record shows who recorded it (§12.1); HR roles go through the roles screen (§4.3).
editEmployee.dateOfJoiningHelp: §11 measures from this date — the six-month eligibility gate, the pro-rated bonus, and effective service net of unpaid leave. A bonus will not compute without it.

pms.noDateOfJoining: Not on file — §11 cannot compute a bonus until this is set
